literature_applicability.gkm_theorem_1_5_object: 2k-th moments of one truncated Mobius divisor sum twisted by a real character
literature_applicability.actual_object: multidimensional Maynard square weight, full-residue edge projection, and FGKMT formula (5.9) reweighting
literature_applicability.dimension: GKM implied constants depend on fixed k; project k grows with X and is at least 10^200
literature_applicability.exceptional_range: GKM part (c) requires exp((log q)^C)<=R<=exp(1/(1-beta)); actual local q is p asymptotic to X and sieve R asymptotic to X^(1/9)

literature_applicability.screen_scope: Scoped primary-source screen, not a global literature nonexistence claim.

not_claimed: No local character-transform theorem exists in the literature.

PAP-11, DEP-R09, fixed 2e-17, or numerical X_cert is closed.
